name: Luxe Leather Sofa
description: Premium Italian leather sofa with a solid oak frame. Three-seater with deep cushions and clean modern lines. Available in cognac, black, and ivory.

name: Walnut Dining Table
description: Solid American walnut dining table with hairpin metal legs. Seats 6 comfortably. Natural grain finish, sealed with food-safe oil.

name: Velvet Accent Chair
description: Curved accent chair upholstered in deep forest-green velvet. Brass-tipped legs and removable cushion. A bold statement piece for any room.

name: Platform Bed Frame
description: Low-profile platform bed in natural ash wood. No box spring needed. Available in Full, Queen, and King sizes. Clean Scandinavian design.

name: Marble Coffee Table
description: White Carrara marble top with a brushed-gold steel base. Lightweight yet sturdy. Adds sophistication to any living space.

name: Bookshelf Unit
description: Floor-to-ceiling modular bookshelf in matte black steel and oak shelves. 5 tiers, adjustable height. Easy self-assembly.
